d:
I've been testing prompts to make furry characters. Here's some rabbits I got. (All characters are fictional characters and above the age of 18 in their non-realities.)

I also started using the blank background since it puts out fewer mistakes. At the same time I'm also testing out a lot of small descriptors so a lot of these might be similar. I haven't done a full library of a furry character yet so I'm figuring out what things look like.

This is a work in progress and I plan on updating it regularly to have all of the positions I usually try to put out on my library works.
